faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Everything you need to know about compliant manpower supply, worker transfers and deployment in Saudi Arabia.

q1.title: How do you ensure compliance with Saudi labour law?
q1.q: We ensure full compliance with Saudi labour law through Qiwa and Muqeem registration, WPS payroll administration, and adherence to Nitaqat standards. All workers are properly documented and insured.

q2.title: What documents are required for application?
q2.q: Applicants need a transferable Iqama or eligible for sponsorship transfer, a valid passport or national ID, and relevant educational or professional certificates. Specific requirements vary by role.

q3.title: How long does the recruitment process take?
q3.q: The process typically takes 2-6 weeks depending on the role, documentation speed, and government processing times for Iqama and Qiwa registration.

apply.title: Apply for a Position
apply.subtitle: Four short steps, about three minutes. Your details go straight to our recruitment team and every application receives a reference number.

step1.label: Position
step1.job: Which position are you applying for?
step1.hint: Choose a live vacancy. If nothing suits you right now, pick the last option and we will keep your details on file for future openings.

step2.label: Personal
step2.hint: These must match your official documents exactly.
step2.idHelp: Optional, but a valid Iqama or National ID speeds up hiring considerably — employers in the Kingdom can only hire candidates who hold one.

step3.label: Experience and CV
step3.hint: Upload an existing CV, or build one free with our ATS-ready generator.
step3.currentJob: Current or Most Recent Job Title
step3.skillsPlaceholder: e.g. Forklift licence, 6G welding certificate, food hygiene, Saudi driving licence
step3.skillsHelp: Separate with commas. Certificates and licences carry the most weight with employers.

step3.cvSize: PDF, DOC or DOCX · maximum 5 MB
step3.noCvDesc: Build a professional, ATS-ready CV in a few minutes. It is free and yours to keep.

step4.label: Review
